note: Hand-curated constants. Items marked verify=true are not present in the official datafeed and are waiting for confirmation by the mechanics research.

level_formula.value: attr(L) = base + gain * (L - 1); derived level-L stat = official level-1 stat + coefficient * (attr(L) - attr(1))
level_formula.source: standard hero progression; no separate attribute-bonus ability exists in the 7.41f datafeed (no ability with 'attribute' in its name on any of 127 heroes)

level_cap.source: mechanics_b.md: since 7.40 talents are taken with separate points at levels 10/15/20/25/27/28/29/30

health_per_str.source: fitted: official herodata max_health - 22*str_base is the constant 120 on all 127 heroes

health_regen_per_str.source: fitted: official herodata health_regen - 0.1*str_base equals dotaconstants base_health_regen on all 127 heroes

mana_per_int.source: fitted: official herodata max_mana - 12*int_base is the constant 75 on 125 of 127 heroes (Huskar 0, Ogre Magi 120 are hero-specific offsets)

mana_regen_per_int.source: fitted: official herodata mana_regen - 0.05*int_base equals dotaconstants base_mana_regen on all 127 heroes

armor_per_agi.source: fitted: official herodata armor - agi_base/6 equals dotaconstants base_armor on all 127 heroes

attack_speed_per_agi.source: standard mechanic, not derivable from datafeed; confirmed by Liquipedia only (mechanics_a.md), not in official notes

base_attack_speed.source: standard mechanic: attacks per second = (100 + bonus attack speed) / (100 * BAT); confirmed by Liquipedia only (mechanics_a.md), not in official notes

damage_per_primary_point.source: fitted: official herodata damage_min - dotaconstants base_attack_min equals the primary attribute base on all 102 str/agi/int heroes

damage_per_point_universal.source: official patch notes 7.38: Universal Heroes' damage per attribute decreased from 0.7 to 0.45
